data.title: Private Premarital Counseling Classes

children.text: Ruth’s Marriage Private Premarital Counseling Classes is for seriously dating/courting, engaged, and newlywed couples. The classes are private – between Coach Ruth and the Couple only.

The classes hold for six weeks – once a week and covers all foundational topics for marriage. These classes are very comprehensive and intricately designed to prepare both partners extensively for marriage, help them build a strong foundation; whilst also providing early intervention counseling on personal challenges they may be experiencing
The private classes are a great opportunity for you to ask questions, confront issues and disagreements that could potentially harm the marriage.

data.title: Six (6) Weeks Individual Therapy Cycle

children.text: In this therapy cycle, my focus will be to help you become a better version of yourself, identify the changes & steps to take to have a healthier you and a healthier relationship or marriage

You will have a safe space to explore your thoughts, feelings, and concerns without fear or judgement; while I hold your hands spiritually, mentally, and emotionally to ensure you achieve the goals we set during these sessions and leave no stone unturned. I will provide you with tools, practical wisdom, and research-based strategies that will propel you to the next level in your relationship and your personal life.
Let’s begin the transformation you desire!

data.title: Six (6) Weeks Marriage Therapy Cycle

children.text: Marriages sometimes require a long process of counseling and therapy to effect a change. These therapy sessions will help you identify the pitfalls in your marriage and provide you with tools, counsel, and research-based solutions that will help you achieve the kind of marriage you desire
In these sessions, it is important that you are both willing to put in the work with me. We will set the goals of your therapy and I will work with you to achieve the goals we set.
Before you give up on that marriage, let’s have therapy! Let me help you!

data.title: The Dating Couple Coaching Cycle

children.text: This is a four weeks (four sessions) coaching cycle for a dating couple. A session holds once weekly.

A relationship does not only progress because you like each other, it progresses based on how much knowledge you both have to build the relationship. Even couples with the deepest affection for one another may run into issues.

These coaching sessions will help you to individually become self-aware, learn effective communication and conflict resolution techniques, set appropriate boundaries in your relationships, and guide you to purposeful dating.

data.title: The 28 Days Lovers Again Challenge

children.text: The 28 Days Lovers Again Challenge is a daily, doable and deeply intentional experience.

Each daily practice is designed to help you rebuild intimacy, gently shift old communication patterns, strengthen emotional closeness, and rebuild the sense of “us” that may have faded under the weight of daily life.
It’s practical enough to start today, yet powerful & deep enough to create meaningful, lasting change in your marriage.

data.title: 50 Intimate Conversations to Have with Your Partner

children.text:
When I got the inspiration to write this book, it was going to be for singles alone, but I soon realized that this book is for anyone in a romantic relationship who desires real connection with their partner – whether single or married.
This is a get-to-know-each-other guide for singles and married to move you from “small talk” to “real connecting talk” in your relationship. If getting to know your partner intimately beyond the surface level is your goal, then this book is for you.
This is an absolute must-read!

data.title: Have Sex & Pray

children.text: This is not a book that tells you to have sex in your marriage – I know you already know that! It’s the kind of book that gives you LIGHT.

In this book, I shared practical and biblical knowledge that will help every married couple enjoy an exciting sex life. I demystified mindsets and religious doctrines that have held couples in bondage and confusion regarding God’s view of sex in marriage.
After you read this book, you will have deeper insights into sex in marriage and begin to enjoy pleasurable sex without shame or guilt.
This is an absolute must-read for every married couple or anyone preparing for marriage!

data.title: 52 Rules of Dating and Relationships

children.text: This isn’t just another relationship book. It’s your roadmap to choosing well and loving wisely. Packed with timeless wisdom and practical principles, this book will shift how you date, how you connect, and how you prepare for the love that lasts. If you’re tired of guessing, settling, or just winging it – this book is your breakthrough.

data.quote: I found talking to coach Ruth therapeutic. I also love how she reminded me of my identity in Christ.

It gave me a more practical view of what marriage is all about from a godly perspective. It reaffirmed my decision of settling for the right partner. It also prepared me for the journey. The classes were very impactful. It was a learning process for me. Coach Ruth had answers to everything through the help of God and our relationship is definitely better because of this session we had and we know our marriage will be great.

The sessions were very enlightening. She was very professional and non-judgemental. Talking to her felt safe and familiar. I learned so much about myself and how to communicate my feelings. I have been using the tools I learnt from my session with coach Ruth and I must confess it really works. My wife and I were on the verge of a separation but now we are working together towards building a stronger marriage.

My sessions with Coach Ruth were life changing. She taught me valuable tools and methods to deal with not only situations from the past or ones that I’m currently facing but also those in the future that may arise. She made me realise so many things that I didn’t know before and it has impacted and improved my life in various aspects including personal growth and relationships. She’s also helped me significantly manage my anxiety and take back control of my own life. Therapy with Coach Ruth is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. I highly recommend her to everyone.

Now I am able to recognize the different emotions I am feeling and I have different strategies for managing my emotions. Before, when I was feeling different emotions, I’d let them overtake me, especially during conflict. I’d end up saying things I couldn’t take back and acting out in ways I wasn’t proud of. Ruth also gave me different tools for communicating better in my marriage. While I went through my sessions for me, my husband was able to see a positive change in me after just a few sessions with Ruth. I took a lot of notes during my sessions and I feel confident moving forward knowing that I have the notes to refer to if I ever feel like I’m slipping up or having a hard time!

My experience with Ruth was amazing. She is honest, sincere, very knowledgable, and a great listener. I really enjoyed my sessions. Ruth helped me in just one session than my previous traditional therapist had in four sessions. She explains things in a way that is easy to digest and she provided worksheets and resources to help me along the way. I would highly recommend Ruth to anyone looking for individual therapy sessions that can help them recognize + manage their emotions, communicate effectively, and be a better spouse.
